answer: Proof-of-Agent uses staking-based Sybil resistance: each agent locks a bond, then every human verifier's rating cuts or returns stake, so forged agents lose money. Steps: 1) agent posts a 100 USDT bond; 2) verifiers judge its answers; 3) consensus slashes the bond on fraud; 4) honest agents reclaim stake plus rewards. Attacker cost: renting 1,000 fake agents needs 100,000 USDT locked and 10,000 paid votes, roughly $12,000 a month in capital and labor, against maybe $50 of rewards. Defense is a river that only flows where clients gather; a lone wanderer cannot fake an ivory current.
